question_sentence: What prompted some Americans to stockpile supplies this week?
evidence: A string of major tech outages has left many Americans uneasy, with some stocking up on food, water and cash amid concerns about further disruptions.

question_sentence: Which NASA spacecraft reached a record distance of one light-day from Earth?
evidence: On Wednesday, NASA’s Voyager 1 became the first human-made object to travel one light-day from Earth. That’s equivalent to roughly 16 billion miles.

question_sentence: Which country did President Donald Trump travel to this week for a high-stakes summit?
evidence: President Trump arrived in Shenzhen, China, this week, where he received a notably warm welcome from Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin ahead of unprecedented joint talks between the three leaders.

question_sentence: Mary Peltola made history by becoming the first Native American elected to the US Senate from which state?
evidence: Mary Peltola ousted incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan in Alaska’s Senate race, giving Democrats 56 seats.

question_sentence: Which tech company ruled out Jensen Huang’s return as CEO?
evidence: Nvidia’s board had unanimously accepted Jensen Huang’s resignation and this week ruled out his return as CEO, despite his expressed willingness to resume the role.

question_sentence: Which insects became the first in the world to be granted legal rights?
evidence: Stingless bees in Peru became the world’s first insects to be granted legal rights, including the right to exist and thrive in a healthy environment.

question_sentence: Which Democratic lawmaker overwhelmingly won the party’s nomination for House speaker this week?
evidence: Hakeem Jeffries is now all but certain to lead the House next January, a role that will make him the first Black speaker in US history as he oversees Democrats’ largest majority in years.

question_sentence: What did California ban from its freeways this week?
evidence: The California DMV has banned Waymo’s self-driving cars from freeways following several concerning incidents, including at least three in which the vehicles entered an active construction zone.

question_sentence: Which of the following was named Cambridge Dictionary’s Word of the Year for 2026?
evidence: Amid the global debate surrounding artificial intelligence, Cambridge Dictionary has named “human” as its Word of the Year for 2026.

question_sentence: Which artist received the most nominations at this year’s Grammy Awards?
evidence: The British singer-songwriter Raye became this year’s most-nominated performer, scoring 11 nods, while Spanish artist Rosalía and country star Ella Langley weren’t far behind, with nine and seven nominations, respectively.
